seo.meta_description: At Skyline Chili, a 3-Way is spaghetti, chili and cheese; a 4-Way adds onions or beans; a 5-Way adds both. How to order and what's in the chili.

question: What Is a 3-Way, 4-Way and 5-Way at Skyline Chili?
quick_answer: At Skyline Chili, the 'way' tells you how many layers are in your bowl. A 3-Way is spaghetti topped with Skyline's chili and a big mound of shredded cheddar. A 4-Way adds either diced onions or beans, so you order a '4-Way onion' or '4-Way bean.' A 5-Way has both onions and beans. Skyline's Cincinnati-style chili is a thin, finely ground meat sauce with warm spices, not a thick Texas-style chili, and it's mild rather than hot.
key_facts: Cincinnati-style chili: thin, mild, warmly spiced

body.heading: The ways, one by one
body.text: Cincinnati chili is ordered by layers. A 2-Way is just spaghetti and chili, though few people order it. A 3-Way adds a heap of finely shredded cheddar cheese on top and is the most popular order. A 4-Way adds one more topping, either diced onions or kidney beans, so you say '4-Way onion' or '4-Way bean.' A 5-Way includes both onions and beans under the cheese.

body.heading: What's in Skyline's chili
body.text: Skyline's chili is a Cincinnati-style chili: a thin, saucy meat sauce made with very finely ground beef and a blend of warm spices. Skyline keeps its recipe secret, but cooks who make copycat versions use spices such as cinnamon, allspice and cloves, sometimes with a little cocoa. It has no beans in the sauce itself (beans are a topping) and is mild, not spicy hot.

body.heading: Coneys and other ways to eat it
body.text: Besides spaghetti ways, Skyline's other classic is the Cheese Coney: a small hot dog in a bun topped with Skyline chili and shredded cheese. You can also order the chili in a bowl on its own. Most orders come with oyster crackers, and many regulars add hot sauce.

body.heading: How much a way costs
body.text: On our Skyline Chili menu page, a classic 3-Way runs about $3.75 to $6.00 depending on size, and a Cheese Coney is about $1.85. 4-Ways and 5-Ways cost a little more than a 3-Way of the same size. Prices vary by location.

body.heading: Where the name comes from
body.text: Skyline Chili dates back to 1949 in Cincinnati, and the name comes from the view of the city skyline from the founder's first restaurant. For full prices, see our Skyline Chili menu page.

faqs.a: Spaghetti topped with Skyline chili and shredded cheddar cheese.
Spaghetti, chili, onions, beans and shredded cheddar cheese.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a 4-Way and a 5-Way?
faqs.a: A 4-Way adds either onions or beans to a 3-Way. A 5-Way adds both.
No. It's warmly spiced but mild, not spicy hot.

faqs.q: Does Skyline chili have beans in it?
faqs.a: Not in the sauce. Beans are added as a topping on 4-Ways and 5-Ways.
